ns2:course.label: Comparative Political Behavior
ns2:course.description: Examines themes of political behavior such as political participation, electoral politics, political culture, and contentious politics from a cross-national perspective. Prerequisite: PS 240, or PS 241, or six hours of Political Science credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 240, or PS 241, or six hours of Political Science credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
